newsitem.title: JAPAN: Uchida Hydraulics plans 3rd-party share allocation.
newsitem.headline: Uchida Hydraulics plans 3rd-party share allocation.

text.p: Uchida Hydraulics Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would issue 10.9 million new shares through a third-party allocation in July.
Uchida Hydraulics said in a statement that all of the new shares will be allocated to Mannesmann Rexroth GmbH of Germany.
As a result, Mannesmann's stake in Uchida Hydraulics will increase to 50.535 percent from the current 25 percent.
The funds raised from the new share issuance, estimated to be worth 4.7 billion yen, will be used to boost the efficiency of production facilities, the company said.
